closeout_operational_negatives.summary: A combined read-only predecessor-script inspection exceeded its wrapper timeout and returned no attributable content; scalar state audit and separate bounded reads recovered without repository mutation.
A broad multi-context patch was rejected because a generated-file anchor did not match exactly; no file changed and exact bounded patches recovered.
The first closeout preflight trimmed Git porcelain framing, truncated the first path, and stopped before artifact generation; raw status parsing recovered.
